channel.title: Palimpsest source index + measurements
channel.description: Palimpsest measurements followed by clearly labeled publisher source records. Source reports remain attributed and are not independently verified unless stated.

item.title: [Palimpsest measurement] Network layer elevated in the latest board synthesis
item.description: Item type: Palimpsest measurement. Result: Upstream board reports: single layer elevated: network. 39 of 39 configured sources report; 33 are live. Health qualifiers: 4 degraded, 2 stale. The board-wide e-value is 4.307; the predeclared board alarm threshold is 20. Limit: A merged e-value measures evidence against no change; it does not identify a common cause for co-movement. Evidence: https://palimpsest.info/readings/board-alarm-latest.json

item.title: [Palimpsest measurement] 12 of 15 configured signals are reporting to the event board
item.description: Item type: Palimpsest measurement. Result: 12 signals are reporting out of 15 configured signals in the current event-flags reading. Limit: Each detector is calibrated to its own history, so equal event values do not imply equal wall-clock rarity. Evidence: https://palimpsest.info/readings/event-flags-latest.json

item.title: [Palimpsest measurement] Coverage changes confound 0 current signal
item.description: Item type: Palimpsest measurement. Result: The current coverage audit marks 0 signal as confounded by its measurement coverage. Limit: A coverage-confounded signal is inconclusive about substantive change, not evidence that no change occurred. Evidence: https://palimpsest.info/readings/coverage-guard-latest.json

item.title: [Palimpsest measurement] Forecast bands covered 84.4% of 1,567 scored readings
item.description: Item type: Palimpsest measurement. Result: Empirical forecast coverage is 84.4% across 1,567 scored forecasts. Limit: Calibration describes aggregate historical coverage and does not guarantee that any one next reading falls inside its band. Evidence: https://palimpsest.info/readings/forecast-ledger-latest.json

item.title: [Palimpsest measurement] 0 cross-layer relationships are confirmed across 8 eligible tests
item.description: Item type: Palimpsest measurement. Result: 0 cross-layer pairs are confirmed among 8 pairs with enough shared history to test. Limit: Lead-lag association can establish temporal co-movement but cannot establish that one layer caused another. Evidence: https://palimpsest.info/readings/cross-layer-latest.json

item.title: [Palimpsest measurement] The directive index now tracks 211 censorship terms
item.description: Item type: Palimpsest measurement. Result: The current deletion-directive index ranks 211 terms with documented censorship provenance. Limit: The index reflects documented and collected directives; it is not a census of every censored term. Evidence: https://palimpsest.info/readings/ddti-latest.json

item.title: [Palimpsest measurement] Global coverage is measurable for 4 of 25 compared terms
item.description: Item type: Palimpsest measurement. Result: GDELT returned usable global coverage for 4 of 25 compared terms. item.description: Item type: Palimpsest measurement. Result: No current finding is published for Silence index because the source status is degraded. item.title: [Palimpsest measurement] Attributable blocklist versions added 503 keywords
item.description: Item type: Palimpsest measurement. Result: The compared attributable client blocklists contain 503 keyword additions. item.description: Item type: Palimpsest measurement. Result: The current ledger ingest published 15 public observations. Evidence: https://palimpsest.info/readings/public-deletion-ledgers-latest.json

item.title: [Palimpsest measurement] UNDERTEXT fuses 2,039 public observations across archive and board readings
item.description: Item type: Palimpsest measurement. Result: The current fusion contains 2,039 observations reconstructed from committed public readings. Evidence: https://palimpsest.info/readings/undertext-latest.json
